entries.label: MGS3 — Zaozyorje West / ravin forestier
entries.prompt: Create ONE wide 16:9 empty static HD painted 2D fighting stage source for CQC Versus Legacy, based carefully on the attached original-game reference. Preserve each game's specific place, architecture, palette and materials. Continuous horizontal walkable fighting strip at the front. Remove every person, vehicle, HUD, scope reticle, annotation, logo and text. No collage, no spritesheet, no UI. Metal Gear Solid 3 original PS2 ZAOZYORJE WEST wooded ravine, not Delta. Reference shows a large moss-covered fallen log spanning a narrow, very deep rocky crevice, massive rough ochre-grey cliffs, cool dark forest above, a little pale scrub at the left. Recreate this defining mossy log bridge and steep gorge in the background of a level stony forest foreground fighting strip. Dusk green-yellow lighting, damp lichen, layered jagged rock, sparse undergrowth. No bright waterfall, no generic suspension bridge, no village, and no aircraft: this image depicts Zaozyorje West itself. Remove Snake, EVA, enemies, frog marker and interface. Preserve restrained original-game atmosphere.

notes: Location and episode checked against the listed screenshot references.
Static painted HD source; perspective, hidden surfaces and fine textures are adapted and not certified as exact 1:1.
No animation, collision layout, parallax separation or runtime admission.
This source covers Zaozyorje West ravine only; the historical scope also mentions the WIG location, which remains separate work.
